title: Sonic Prime
description: After shattering the reality-bending Paradox Prism, Sonic races through strange new worlds to reunite his friends and restore the universe.

episodes.title: Shattered
episodes.file: Sonic Prime - S01E01 - Shattered.mp4
episodes.description: Sonic shatters the Paradox Prism during a battle with Dr. Eggman and awakens in the dystopian New Yoke City.

episodes.title: The Yoke's on You
episodes.file: Sonic Prime - S01E02 - The Yoke's on You.mp4
episodes.description: Sonic's energy surge draws the Chaos Council's attention while the Resistance attempts a rescue.

episodes.title: Escape from New Yoke
episodes.file: Sonic Prime - S01E03 - Escape from New Yoke.mp4
episodes.description: Sonic, Nine, and the Resistance try to steal the crystal powering the Chaos Council's city.

episodes.title: Unwelcome to the Jungle
episodes.file: Sonic Prime - S01E04 - Unwelcome to the Jungle.mp4
episodes.description: Sonic lands in the Boscage Maze and is caught between Thorn Rose and a band of scavengers.

episodes.title: Barking Up the Wrong Tree
episodes.file: Sonic Prime - S01E05 - Barking Up the Wrong Tree.mp4
episodes.description: Sonic tries to reconcile Thorn Rose and the scavengers before claiming another Prism shard.

episodes.title: Situation: Grim
episodes.file: Sonic Prime - S01E06 - Situation Grim.mp4
episodes.description: Sonic returns to a war-torn New Yoke City and discovers Nine's plans for the barren Grim.

episodes.title: It Takes One to No Place
episodes.file: Sonic Prime - S01E07 - It Takes One to No Place.mp4
episodes.description: Sonic reaches the pirate world of No Place and joins Knuckles the Dread's hunt for a Prism shard.

episodes.title: There's No ARRGH in Team
episodes.file: Sonic Prime - S01E08 - There's No ARRGH in Team.mp4
episodes.description: Sonic and the pirates battle Rusty Rose while the Chaos Council turns Nine's technology against the Shatterverse.

episodes.title: Avoid the Void
episodes.file: Sonic Prime - S02E01 - Avoid the Void.mp4
episodes.description: Shadow confronts Sonic in the Void as the Chaos Council begins its invasion of the Shatterspaces.

episodes.title: Battle in the Boscage
episodes.file: Sonic Prime - S02E02 - Battle in the Boscage.mp4
episodes.description: Sonic helps Thorn Rose defend the Boscage Maze while Nine secretly upgrades his equipment.

episodes.title: Second Wind
episodes.file: Sonic Prime - S02E03 - Second Wind.mp4
episodes.description: Sonic rejoins the pirates of No Place to pursue the Chaos Council and recover another shard.

episodes.title: No Way Out
episodes.file: Sonic Prime - S02E04 - No Way Out.mp4
episodes.description: Dread's betrayal leaves Sonic pursued by pirates and the Chaos Council across No Place.

episodes.title: A Madness to Their Methods
episodes.file: Sonic Prime - S02E05 - A Madness to Their Methods.mp4
episodes.description: Sonic and the Resistance fight upgraded Eggforcers as Nine guides them into the Council's fortress.

episodes.title: Double Trouble
episodes.file: Sonic Prime - S02E06 - Double Trouble.mp4
episodes.description: Sonic battles his robotic double, Chaos Sonic, while Nine makes a daring escape.

episodes.title: Cracking Down
episodes.file: Sonic Prime - S02E07 - Cracking Down.mp4
episodes.description: Sonic and Nine race through multiple Shatterspaces with the Prism shards and the Council close behind.

episodes.title: Ghost of a Chance
episodes.file: Sonic Prime - S02E08 - Ghost of a Chance.mp4
episodes.description: Sonic and Shadow defend Nine as he rebuilds the Paradox Prism in Ghost Hill.

episodes.title: Grim Tidings
episodes.file: Sonic Prime - S03E01 - Grim Tidings.mp4
episodes.description: Nine takes control of the Prism and turns the Grim into his new home while Sonic searches for a way forward.

episodes.title: Dome Sweet Dome
episodes.file: Sonic Prime - S03E02 - Dome Sweet Dome.mp4
episodes.description: Sonic and Shadow struggle against Nine's defenses as the Shatterverse begins to destabilize.

episodes.title: No Escape
episodes.file: Sonic Prime - S03E03 - No Escape.mp4
episodes.description: Sonic gathers allies from across the Shatterspaces for a desperate stand against Nine.

episodes.title: Nine's Lives
episodes.file: Sonic Prime - S03E04 - Nine's Lives.mp4
episodes.description: The united Resistance faces Nine's growing army of robotic Grimions.

episodes.title: Home Sick Home
episodes.file: Sonic Prime - S03E05 - Home Sick Home.mp4
episodes.description: Sonic's allies launch an assault on Nine's fortress while Grim Big threatens their entire force.

episodes.title: The Devil Is in the Tails
episodes.file: Sonic Prime - S03E06 - The Devil Is in the Tails.mp4
episodes.description: Sonic battles Nine directly as the Resistance executes a plan to weaken his robot army.

episodes.title: From the Top
episodes.file: Sonic Prime - S03E07 - From the Top.mp4
episodes.description: Sonic and Nine face the consequences of the shattered Prism and make one final attempt to save every reality.
